import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    lt=np.log(t); lP=np.log(P)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**3
            + np.sqrt(1+t)*p[3]*np.sqrt(P)
            + t*p[4]*lP
            + np.sqrt(t)*p[5]
            + lt*(p[6]*P*lP+p[7]*P**2)
            + p[8]*P*lP + p[9]*np.log(1+t)/P)
